title: ID0453791-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / R7 170002207] PowerConverter Issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:  PowerConverter Issue
Solution:
Following the procedure for diagnosing a power converter issue, and after our check, as shown in the screenshot I sent, we can see that converter number 13 is faulty.
There are three possible solutions:
First, check the AC-DC cables attached to that converter. If they are properly connected, proceed to the next step.
Try swapping the converter that shows the issue with the one beside it. This will help confirm whether the problem lies in the cables or in the converter itself. If the issue remains after swapping, it confirms that the converter itself is faulty. In that case, replace the converter.
Worked on by Calin Ienei
